thread:
Marta: Morning PSA: the office French press broke (handle snapped) and theres coffee grounds EVERYWHERE in the bin under the counter. Anyone know who used it last? :coffee::cry:
Leo: Oof. I used it yesterday morning, the handle felt loose but I thought it was fine. Sorry! I'll clean it and toss the grounds.
Anika: If were replacing it, can we get a small French press + spare filter baskets? Theyre cheap and save the office from instant coffee.
Devon: Seconded. Also suggest a labelled drawer for personal snacks vs shared snacks. People keep mixing granola from home with pantry, causing confusion.
Marta: Good idea. Maybe a simple sticker: "Shared" vs "Personal" and a small box for "Community stash (take/leave)".
kitchen-bot: Reminder: "Coffee kit check" scheduled Wednesdays @ 10am. React :thumbsup: to confirm attendance.
Leo: Ill pick up a press + filters (small one) on my way home tonight. Also Ill bring a small scoop so we stop pouring straight from the bag.
Anika: Thank you! Can we also get a labeled container for coffee grounds to compost? saves the spill drama.
Devon: Poll quick: keep a weekly snack run (Friday) or ad-hoc donations? :one: weekly :two: ad-hoc
Marta: :one:
Leo: :one:
Anika: :two: (I can donate occasionally)
Devon: Looks like weekly still wins, but well keep ad-hoc as backup. Thanks everyone. :coffee:
